usage: 滑鼠 (waat6 syu2) is used as a noun to refer to the computer mouse device.
You can use 滑鼠 as the subject or object in a sentence, like '我買咗個新滑鼠' (I bought a new mouse).
When giving commands or instructions, 滑鼠 can be used with verbs like 點擊 (click) or 拖拉 (drag).
It is common to use 滑鼠 with possessive markers, for example '佢嘅滑鼠壞咗' means 'His mouse is broken.'
滑鼠 can also be combined with other words to describe features, such as 無線滑鼠 (wireless mouse).
